changes.comment: Add octahedral foliage impostors with dithered cross-fade, LOD-based baking, WebGL2 support and foliage transmission in PBR and blueprint materials.
Add Mesh.drawDistance with per-instance GPU distance culling.
Add RoadSpline, a spline road blended into the terrain that can fit the terrain and clear grass and foliage along it.
Improve procedural grass with detail level chains, per-layer shadow casting, self-shadowing, ground darkening and a runtime switch.
Time-slice sky light updates and add volumetric cloud shadow maps that also shade the atmosphere and GI.
Improve performance of water shading, waterline and shore field updates, virtual texture page marking and filling, and GPU grass placement.
Fix pickAsync returning the hit x coordinate instead of the distance.
Fix loadSceneFromFile, particle burst limits, GPU pick framebuffer buildup, hidden node physics, impostor shading and other issues.
Improve performance of the WebGPU ocean FFT by transforming each line in a single group-shared dispatch.

Improve performance of the water foam field: step every level in one WebGPU dispatch, skip steps of no time, read the waves over each cell's footprint, read the shore field once per cell and step the coarser levels less often.
Draw volumetric clouds on WebGL2, generating the noise volumes and tracing the sky cache with full-screen draws where WebGPU uses compute; cloud shadow maps remain WebGPU-only.
